quality_flags.detail: [altflow_diverge_points] Alternative flow claim 3 says it diverges from the main-flow bid-amount selection step where the Customer selects an amount from the 'Your SmartBid' or 'Your Single Bid' dropdowns, but main_flow contains no such step. Main_flow goes from clicking 'Place Single Bid' directly to a confirmation popup; the popup only states the bid amount and does not have the Customer select from dropdowns. The attachment point is therefore nonexistent/out-of-range. (atomic grounding: candidate remains incomplete (recovery/exit behavior after the QuickBid Now divergence is not supported by cited evidence))

[altflow_diverge_points] Alternative flow claim 2 says it diverges from the main-flow entry point on the Product Details page, but main_flow has no 'entry point' step and the described action takes place on the Category Page List View. The attachment point is therefore nonexistent/logically unrelated to the PDP-based main flow. (atomic grounding: candidate remains incomplete (Explicit evidence that the main-flow bid submission occurs on the Product Details page and that the Category Page List View QuickBid action bypasses navigation to that page.))

[trigger_preconditions_coverage] The Trigger requires the Customer to choose a bid amount and click a Place Bid button, which is only possible if the auction item is currently in an open/accepting-bids state. Preconditions does not assert this; it only contains a conditional business rule that the auction may remain open after its scheduled closing time when overtime bidding is enabled. Therefore the precondition needed to initiate the Trigger is missing.

[altflow_diverge_points] Alternative flow claim 4 states it diverges from the 'main-flow single-bid path' by using SmartBid, but main_flow step 1 already presents 'Place SmartBid' and 'Place Single Bid' as two button options within the same flow, and no later main_flow step defines a separate single-bid path. The stated divergence point therefore does not map to an existing main_flow step/branch.

[altflow_diverge_points] Alternative flow claim 5 says it diverges from the 'main-flow bid-submission step', but the described behavior is an alternate entry from the Category Page List View via a SmartBid button. That is an entry-point variation, not a divergence at the bid-submission step, so the claimed attachment point is logically unrelated/out-of-range.
